proposals.title: Martin Haugh — Forwards, Swaps, Futures and Options (2016)
proposals.use: Section 4: European parity, payoff bounds, two-state replication and multi-period stock/cash valuation. All Linden examples and problems are original.
proposals.verification: Primary author course PDF body retrieved and Section 4.1–4.2 plus multi-period material inspected. Historical teaching notes, not current market terms.

proposals.title: Martin Haugh — Martingale Pricing Theory in Discrete-Time and Discrete-Space Models (2016)
proposals.use: Finite self-financing stock/cash strategies, conditional martingale valuation and American exercise backward recursion. The chapter supplies its own bounded finite proof and original numerical cases.
proposals.verification: Primary author course PDF body retrieved; self-financing discussion on printed pages 10–12 and American pricing/stopping material on printed pages 25–27 inspected. No infinite-horizon stopping theorem is claimed.

source_policy: Bodies inspected only for the stated scopes; derivations, examples, problems and software are original. Source validity does not itself certify this manuscript.
